protocol.comparison: Fresh same550 tensors, same data seed, optimizer, scheduler horizon, loss and64dim state. Full vs spatial vs shuffled addressing; CLS visible to every query.
protocol.motivation: Same-dimensional frozen probes localize weak TwoRoom position readout after global QueryPool. This does not prove useful dynamics or a sufficient solution.
limitations: Fixed image quadrants introduce a spatial prior; this is a mechanism diagnostic, not a novelty claim.
ViT tokens already have global receptive fields; only pooling address support is restricted.
Shuffled partitions control support size but not all conditioning changes.
600 steps remain in warmup; inspect full-state, gradients, functional use and task scores before continuation.
protocol.next_review: No automatic continuation beyond600. Preserve all old held campaigns and every seed.
